$comment: Route set from the clone's real route table (src/route-modules/*.js, enumerated by design-repo/extraction/enumerate_routes.mjs) cross-checked with the live sitemap (glaze.app/sitemap.xml) and recon in specs/ and CLONE_SPEC.md. design-repo/templates/templates.json and this file are generated from the same template definitions and checked against each other by design-repo/extraction/verify_all.py. implementedBy is the source file that renders the section.

meta.source: https://www.glaze.app (sitemap + Playwright recon); clone at this project root
meta.status: built: all 13 templates exist in src/; the route table is the clone's own (src/route-modules/*.js): 16 static routes, /blog/:slug (4 posts), /store/:category (8), /app/:slug (265-app snapshot) and the catch-all. Long-form pages are decomposed into header, body and footer-type sections (legal, article, release entries). The live sitemap lists 1924 app pages (1953 routes); the clone serves its 265-app snapshot.

categories.SHELL: Chrome shared across pages: navigation, footer, overlays.
categories.HERO: Page-opening header block (landing hero, page title, awards hero).
categories.SHOWCASE: Product-in-use displays: app tabs, award winners and entries.
categories.CTA: Calls to download or act (conversion blocks, closing the page above the footer).
categories.CONTENT: Body content of a page: legal text, articles, release entries, awards blocks, error states.
categories.STORE: App store browsing and app detail blocks.

commerce.pricing-plans.description: Plan comparison cards with prices and feature lists.

content.article-body.description: Blog post header (title, date, author, hero image) and prose body.

content.article-cover.description: Blog post cover image in a rounded, bordered frame (aspect 1.9:1).

content.article-footer.description: Closing row of a post: author, dot, date, and a Share button that uses the share sheet or copies the link ('Copied' for 1600ms).

content.article-header.description: Post date, title and author row.

content.award-criteria.description: 'Selection criteria' heading and up to six criteria, each an icon, a title and a short paragraph; 1, 2 and 3 per row at 0, 700 and 1000.

content.award-jury.description: 'The jury' heading and up to five greyscale juror portraits with name, 'Role, Organisation' and link icons; 3 per row below 760, 5 across from 760.

content.award-prizes.description: Bordered fieldset with a centred legend ('Cash prizes for winners') and four prize cards (medal, tier, amount), plus an 'Eligible Countries' tooltip trigger under it.

content.legal-body.description: Long-form legal text in a 640px column: h2 and h3 headings, paragraphs (optional bold label lead and trailing links), bullet lists with one nested level, and for the awards terms a Schedule divider.
content.legal-body.scope: Terms, privacy, acceptable use and the awards terms (typography policy or terms) (4 routes in total).

content.legal-header.description: Legal page title (one or two balanced lines) and a 'Last Updated' line.
content.legal-header.scope: Terms, privacy, acceptable use and the awards terms (4 routes in total).

content.not-found-block.description: Centered error state with the clickable app icon, 'Page not found' heading, one sentence and a Go Home button.
content.not-found-block.scope: The catch-all not-found route (also /m and the showcase tab ids, which are not routes) (1 route in total).

content.post-card.description: One blog post in the index: cover image, date, title (a link to the post), author row and excerpt. Repeated once per post, separated by a hairline.

content.release-entry.description: One changelog release: version pill and date (sticky beside the entry from 1280), a linked release title, then prose blocks (h2 groups, paragraphs, bullet lists, images). Repeated newest first, separated by a hairline.

cta.download-compact.description: Compact closing call to action under a blog post: smaller icon, 'What will you build?'-style headline, Download button (>=480) or a one-line availability note (<480).

cta.download-icon.description: Large app icon that launches a burst of flying app icons on click, with the 'What will you build?' headline and download buttons.
cta.download-icon.scope: Landing, persona, pricing and awards routes (8 routes in total).

cta.download-page.description: Dedicated download page with the installer call to action and system requirements.

features.feature-grid.description: Six feature cards laid out 1 / 2 / 2 / 1, switching to mobile images below 800px.
features.feature-grid.scope: Landing and persona routes (6 routes in total).

hero.awards-hero.description: Awards opening block on a black page: a looping video (full-bleed, 16:9, side fades), then a sponsor row, a display title and a subtitle that overlap the video bottom edge.

hero.landing-hero.description: Eyebrow, two-line headline, subtext, Download and Reinvent-your-wheel buttons, requirements note, autoplay loop video and three pillars; headline and subtext are swapped per persona route.
hero.landing-hero.scope: Landing and persona routes (6 routes in total).

hero.page-header.description: Centred page title with a one-line subtitle in a 680px column (blog index and changelog).
hero.page-header.scope: Blog index and changelog (2 routes in total).

hero.page-title.description: Centred display page title with no subtitle (the pricing page).
hero.page-title.scope: Pricing. Pages with a subtitle use hero.page-header (1 route in total).

shell.app-dialog.description: Centred dialog opened from an app card (landing persona tabs) or a winner card (awards): app detail body (or a winner summary) with a close button and previous/next app buttons; scroll lock, Escape closes, Arrow keys step through the opener's apps.
shell.app-dialog.scope: Landing, persona routes and awards, opened on demand (7 routes in total).

shell.footer.description: Bottom footer with legal links, socials and the Raycast credit.
shell.footer.scope: Every route except /download (293 routes in total).

shell.image-lightbox.description: Full-screen gallery of the post's images: black backdrop, current image at 70vw with neighbours at 60% opacity, arrows and Escape, backdrop click closes.
shell.image-lightbox.scope: Blog posts, opened on demand (4 routes in total).

shell.navbar.description: Fixed top navigation: glass pill on desktop (brand, Home, Pricing, Store, Blog, Changelog, Sign in) and a slide-down panel on mobile, with an active-link dot.

shell.youtube-overlay.description: Full-screen YouTube embed dialog opened from hero and feature demo buttons; locks scroll, closes on Esc or backdrop.
shell.youtube-overlay.scope: Landing and persona routes (6 routes in total).

showcase.award-entries.description: 'Browse N Entries' heading with a search pill, a 2/3/4-column grid of app rows (24 per page) and numbered pagination; search replaces the heading with a result count and hides the pager.

showcase.award-winners.description: Gold winner card full width, silver and bronze side by side (stacked below 624), then a 'Finalists' title and a grid of app rows. Winner cards open the app dialog.

showcase.persona-tabs.description: Six audience tabs (dropdown below 800px) each showing a four-app grid, with company logos on the team tab; the starting tab depends on the route.
showcase.persona-tabs.scope: Landing and persona routes (6 routes in total).

store.app-about.description: Balanced description paragraph under a screen-reader-only 'About <app>' heading.
store.app-about.scope: App detail pages (265 routes in total).

store.app-grid.description: Grid of app cards (icon, name, tagline, author) for the store index or one category.
store.app-grid.scope: Store category pages (and store search results) (8 routes in total).

store.app-header.description: App detail header: squircle icon (112 from 480), name, award pill, optional Glaze-AI badge, tagline and two actions. With a featured image the block is a rounded cover with a bottom gradient and a 'Featured' pill; without one it is plain.
store.app-header.scope: App detail pages (/app/<slug>) (265 routes in total).

store.app-list.description: Titled two-column list of app rows ('Remixes', 'Suggested Apps'); the remix list marks each row with a shuffle glyph.
store.app-list.scope: App detail pages (265 routes in total).

store.app-shelves.description: Store home shelves (Our Picks, Trending, Made to Remix, Award Winners, Latest): a title with an optional 'View All' link and paged slider arrows, then pages of app rows (1/2/3/4 columns).

store.app-stats.description: Four-cell bordered strip: Author (avatar and name), Size, Updated, Installs.
store.app-stats.scope: App detail pages (265 routes in total).

store.category-nav.description: Row of store category links (remixable, developer tools, productivity, utilities, media, design, lifestyle, games and fun).
store.category-nav.scope: Store index and store category pages (9 routes in total).

store.featured-carousel.description: Full-width carousel of featured apps: five-card window of 960-wide cover cards (rounded, bottom gradient, icon, name, award pill, tagline), autoplay every 4000ms, drag, wheel, arrows on hover and dot indicators.
store.featured-carousel.scope: Store index and store category pages (9 routes in total).

store.remix-lineage.description: Banner under the header for a remixed app: 'Remixed from <app> by <author>' with a shuffle glyph.
store.remix-lineage.scope: App detail pages of remixed apps (265 routes in total).

store.screenshot-strip.description: Horizontal scroll-snap strip of screenshots (220 tall, 260 from 480) with edge fades and arrow buttons; a click opens the lightbox.
store.screenshot-strip.scope: App detail pages with screenshots (265 routes in total).

support.faq.description: Ten-question single-open accordion that dims to 15% opacity once scrolled past.
support.faq.scope: Landing, persona and pricing routes (the pricing page has a longer list) (7 routes in total).
